Class MonoidObject (mon : C) := { mempty : I ~> mon; mappend : mon ⨂ mon ~> mon; mempty_left; mempty_right; mappend_assoc } — supplies the associativity + two-sided-unit laws the group object inherits

statement_record.book: In a category C with finite products, a group object is an object G with m:G×G→G, u:1→G, i:G→G satisfying associativity, two-sided unit (both triangles), and two-sided inverse m∘(1×i)∘Δ = u∘! = m∘(i×1)∘Δ.
